Company Description
 Inetum is a European leader in digital services. For businesses, public sector organizations, and society as a whole, the group’s 26,000 consultants and specialists work every day to create tangible digital impact: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation, and the common good.
With a presence in 19 countries, working closely with local communities, and alongside its major software developer partners, Inetum supports organizations in their digital transformation challenges with proximity, flexibility, and responsibility. Driven by its purpose, Inetum champions a vision of technology that is useful and well-managed, capable of unlocking the full potential of organizations and society: “Let’s make tech right.”
In 2025, the group generated revenue of 2.2 billion euros.
More information at: www.inetum.com
 Job Description
Analyzing product requirements and specifications.
Propose a mobile test automation strategy/plan, facilitating automated scripts, maintenance and design
Design test scenarios and cases ensuring there is traceability back to all business requirements
Maintain existing automation scripts whenever necessary following functional changes for the respective flow/application
Defines requirements for test data
Ensures adherence to testing best practices and the Client's testing standards
Integrate automated tests into the continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipeline to ensure early detection of defects and provide rapid feedback to development teams
Perform the automated execution results analysis and debug automated test scripts
Identify, document, and report software defects and inconsistencies using bug tracking systems
Create clear and concise test documentation, including test plans, test cases, and test scripts, to facilitate knowledge transfer and maintain consistency in testing processes
Create test reports / Support test reports / Support risk assessment
 Qualifications
3+ Years of experience in UI Mobile Test Automation on both iOS and Android with the following tech stack: JavaScript, WebdriverIO, Cucumber, BrowserStack, Allure (or any other reporting tool)
Proven experience with NPM: Install/updating dependencies, configuring and running custom scripts in package.json
Proven experience in API automation testing with the following tech stack: REST Assured (Java) and/or Super-Agent(JS)/Axios/Supertest 
Proven experience with Git workflows (push, pull, merge, fetch, rebase, etc.)
Previous experience with manual REST API testing in Postman, Bruno 
Manual testing in BrowserStack and/ or on-site devices iOS & Android 
Extensive knowledge of mobile testing concepts, methodologies, tools, and best practices
Extensive experience with test management tools like Octane, Jira 
Experience of planning and executing testing across all layers
Good testing and troubleshooting experience across the software development lifecycle
Good planning, organization, time management skills to prioritize and manage multiple testing effort
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to communicate efficiently with the team (business, developers, PM)
Effective communication skills for conveying test strategies & plan for automation
Detail-oriented with a user-centric mindset
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Knowledge of Agile methodology
Very good/advanced level of English
Experience in banking projects

Hands-on experience with CI/CD: Azure DevOps, GitLab pipelines configurations
